text: When a family returns food or medication, the money goes back the way it came. A card payment goes back to the card.
Open the paid bill. Maria paid for this bag of food with her card.
Scout shows how the bill was paid.
It goes back on the shelf, and the whole amount goes back to the card.
The bill stays Paid, with nothing due.
And the refund line reads refunded.
If they paid with account credit, that part goes back as credit.
